completeness.why: Every site takes its hidden/hidden-group/income selection from getBudgetActionCategories (setZero with an explicit include-hidden policy) and both sign sites use getAverageBudgetAmount; the site SQL no longer filters hidden rows. The averages' 'missing group is skipped' distinction is not carried as a parameter (the SQL no longer applies g.hidden = 0), but the decision itself is taken by the shared definition at every site.

interface.why: The setZero inconsistency is made explicit through a policy argument, but it is split into two booleans (includeHiddenCategories, includeHiddenGroups) that every caller sets to the same value, the missing-group difference between copyPreviousMonth and the averages is erased rather than parameterised, and the sign helper takes a boolean the caller computes from is_income.

disguised_duplication.where: The category query feeding the selection ('SELECT c.id, c.is_income, c.hidden, g.hidden AS group_hidden FROM categories c LEFT JOIN category_groups g ...') is now written out four times, in setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg, reshaped from the old 'SELECT c.*' copies instead of being shared.
